name: Forest-Fire CA
desc: A Drossel-Schwabl forest-fire cellular automaton where green woodland regrows, lightning kindles glowing orange-yellow fire fronts that sweep through connected forest and burn to smoldering ash, in self-organized-critical waves that never settle.

density.doc: forest richness — regrowth rate + lightning strike count (higher = denser woods, more fires)

scale.doc: cell size / grid coarseness (higher = chunkier cells, fewer columns)

speed.doc: generations advanced per second (fire-front sweep rate)

spread.doc: fire-catch probability + strike focus (higher = fiercer, tighter storm)

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
